name: TVer(ティーバー) 民放公式テレビ配信サービス

sources.label: Morphe patch for TVer
sources.author: yuubinnkyoku TVer
patch_list: Automatically enter system PiP for replay episodes and live/DVR playback; excludes paused replay episodes and home previews.
TVer: keep live playback in background (7.2.1/7.4.1)
Live/DVR streams keep playing (audio, and video via PiP) when the app itself is backgrounded, e.g. Home gesture, while in-app navigation and modal sheets pause/release them as in the stock app.
TVer: live pre-roll and companion ad suppression (7.2.1/7.4.1)
Skip the client-side pre-roll ad on live/DVR starts and never hand companion ads to the live overlay. SSAI mid-rolls stitched into the stream are out of scope.
Choose live/DVR video resolutions from the actual rendition list (Auto, 1080p, 720p, etc.) instead of the fixed 4-choice quality sheet.

Raise the realtime-live and DVR AUTO/HIGH max video size from 720p (1280x720) to 1080p (1920x1080). MEDIUM/LOW stay unchanged, and playback falls back to the best rendition the broadcaster actually publishes.
Experimental transparent WebView with offline test comments and episode playback synchronization.
Choose available video resolutions from a list (Auto, 1080p, 720p, etc.) and allow 1080p on phones for regular VOD.

Experimental: suppress the splash version gate dialogs (forced store redirect and newest-version recommendation) by making ForceUpdateUtil.shouldForceUpdate return false. Content APIs are not modified.
Experimentally suppress selected player ad requests and hooks; full ad blocking is not guaranteed.
